description: Least-privilege writer for typed peer task results. libs/core/mesh/peer-task-exchange.ts assumes it, bound to the receiving tenant, after the recipient operator accepts a peer task: it writes the task report and output log under active/shared/artifacts/confidential/<tenant>/report/peer-tasks/ and appends that tenant's scoped artifact index, and reads only those paths (persona worker). It is tenant-bound (authority.ts TENANT_BOUND_READER_ROLES): the bound tenant must be explicit and equal the caller's active tenant when one exists.
